stemMd: A solution changes from pH 5 to pH 3. By what factor does its hydrogen-ion concentration increase?
explanationMd: Each decrease of one pH unit means a tenfold increase in hydrogen-ion concentration. A two-unit decrease therefore gives 10 squared, or a hundredfold increase.

distractorRationale.e: This would correspond to three pH units.
distractorRationale.c: One pH unit, not two, corresponds to a tenfold change.
distractorRationale.b: The pH difference is not a linear concentration ratio.
distractorRationale.a: This reverses the direction of the change.
